text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, having reached a milestone, we 
went on the 'reward trip' we had promised 
earlier."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, carbonation, mineral deposits... 
Japanese hot springs really go all out, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I can smell such a wonderful aroma all the 
way over here. Heheh. I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aaah, that was a nice bath.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The big bath in the dorm is lively and 
nice, sure, but soaking slowly like this 
is pretty darn great too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm toasty warm right down to my core.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"—Guess it's about dinner time. Let's get 
going, Trainee-boy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~! What is this? It's so good~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was thrilled by the lavish 
multi-course kaiseki meal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"What's the deal with this chawanmushi? 
The broth is probably... bonito? No, 
kelp?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Could be that the eggs themselves are just 
different. Dammit, why does this taste so 
good?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. Alright, I've 
decided!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely figuring out that recipe 
once we're back! You better look forward 
to it, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having a lively, enjoyable meal 
together—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainy. My belly's full now, so 
how about we go for a little stroll?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to take a walk to help digest 
our food.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! What a nice breeze! It's quiet, the 
air tastes great, the sky is beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Somehow, it reminds me of home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Brings back memories. My family and 
I used to go on walks just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Strolling leisurely along the path between 
the fields, the two of them look up at the 
night sky.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When I won the lottery, I just invited you 
on a whim, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, looking back now, coming with you 
was definitely the right choice.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No... I can't quite put it into words, 
but y'know. How should I say it...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even I find it strange. There are so many 
people who are precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The Miho Dorm girls, the dependable Fuji 
Kiseki... and Brian, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I've spent just as much meaningful time 
with them at the academy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still... I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if searching for words, Hishi Amazon 
looked up at the sky again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Warming up my body, eating tasty food, and 
looking up at the sky in pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I realized that this view right now only 
means something because I'm with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's vast, beautiful, and full of hope.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought, today's sky looks a 
lot like the one I saw with my family back 
then."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"—Well, that was a bit unlike me! Fuji's 
theatrical flair must be rubbing off on 
me."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head home before it gets 
cold!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hishi Amazon hurried off to go home, 
her profile looked slightly flushed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Hishi Amazon...
